source: Original manual printed pp19,26-27,86,90-91; native premium XML influenceBonus=0.5

emulator_policy.decay: 2.5% nominal daily rate divided into 24 hourly charges, fractional charges carry forward. Existing clan levels0/1 correspond to manual capacities10/16 and rates1/1.5; level2 rate2 is explicit policy because manual does not specify the largest clan rate. First observation starts the clock; no retroactive hosted-save decay.
emulator_policy.multipliers: Multiply city, premium, highest earned achievement influence coefficient and highest permanent assault medal. Repeated medals and multiple achievement coefficients use their maximum, not unbounded stacking; stacking and medal magnitudes are unrecovered policy.
emulator_policy.assault_rewards: One stored golden range token and one emulator Light Trainer5003 per positive contested top20 player on each side. Counts, booster choice and medal coefficients are policy; the manual only identifies these reward categories.
emulator_policy.defense_fund: Manual printed86 confirms personal Credits from any willing player and50/30/20 to top3 defender clans regardless of winner. Server policy: only REGISTRATION before authoritative starts; fewer positive contested defenders normalize weights, integer remainder by rank. No eligible defenders refunds new personal donations to original wallets (overflow remains durable pending) and legacy clan-funded remainder to original clan; refund rule and cutoff are not recovered historical rules.
emulator_policy.weekly: Monday00:00 UTC calendar weeks; ties resolve by clan ID. Only positive contested finalized scores count. Badges apply to current members, including late joiners, and expire at the following weekly boundary.
emulator_policy.sales: Tax is included in credit sale gross; floor(gross*rate/100) goes to the controlling clan and remainder to the seller. Premium excluded. Purchase-side charge incidence is explicit policy.
emulator_policy.schedule: Offer12/15/18/21 UTC on the base's existing weekday. Root scheduler consumes scheduled_start before creating the next event; selection never changes the weekly day or already-created event.
emulator_policy.wire: No historical upload, medal or schedule opcode is invented. Existing crest-ID fields can project stored IDs; root must integrate native content transport or an explicit emulator command separately.
